item.title: Patch now: Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server: OS Command Injection
item.description:
Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server: RCE · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 26.4.303

First step: Update Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server to 26.4.303 or later.

Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-110447
